summary.text: Tom Jones is a Republican state representative from Lancaster County who has represented Pennsylvania House District 98 since December 2022 and is the Republican candidate for Pennsylvania Senate District 36 in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democratic incumbent James Malone.

paragraphs.text: Tom Jones graduated from Lancaster Catholic High School in 1992, according to Ballotpedia, and his career experience includes owning and operating a landscaping business.

He chaired the East Donegal Township board of supervisors, served as a police commissioner for the Susquehanna Regional Police Department and director of the Maytown/East Donegal Township Fire Department, and became a member of the Lancaster County Planning Commission.
Jones assumed office in the state House on December 1, 2022, succeeding David Hickernell.
For the 2023-2024 session, Ballotpedia lists his committee assignments as Urban Affairs and Housing and Local Government.
His campaign website describes him as a local business owner and lifelong Lancaster County resident who raised four children with his wife, Rochelle, in Maytown.

It lists his Senate priorities as restoring fiscal responsibility, expanding health care options that lower costs, expanding economic opportunity, directing education dollars to students, and supporting term limits.
